intent.audience: founders and team leads at companies with 5-20 people
intent.objective: Get readers to start a free TaskNest trial

brand.guidelines:
Write like a calm, knowledgeable colleague.

brand.example_content: You don't need a complicated system to keep work moving. Start with a shared list of tasks, give each one an owner and a date, and review it together on Mondays. When something slips, you'll see it early. That's the whole point: fewer surprises, calmer weeks, and work you can actually finish. We built TaskNest so you can set this up in an afternoon.
